# `browser-extension/background.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/background.js`

background.js — WebGPU OS Frame Unblocker + Browser Bridge service worker. Static rules (rules.json) are the primary mechanism. Dynamic rules (updateDynamicRules) are registered as a fallback on every startup in case Chrome silently rejected the static ruleset. Browser Bridge: handles __os_bridge_request__ messages routed from relay.js, delegating to the four service modules (Tabs, Injection, Navigation, Rules).
